resources.title: Selected main dams in Morocco
resources.producer: Ministère de l’Équipement et de l’Eau — Maadialna
resources.review_basis: Official public dashboard; no explicit reuse grant identified.
notes: The source describes selected main dams in nine basins, not all dams in Morocco.

The source JSON has no observation date. 2026-10-12 is taken from the national dashboard headline and is marked dashboard_headline on every imported observation; its applicability to each dam is not independently confirmed.
Capacity is not published for these dam entries and remains null; it is not inferred from rounded filling percentages.
Arabic names, volumes and filling percentages are preserved. French names are null unless already supplied by the separate ABHT source.
The previous-year percentage is a comparison value in the current snapshot, not an independently dated historical observation.
resources.attribution: Contains selected dam figures published by Ministère de l’Équipement et de l’Eau on Maadialna, retrieved from https://maadialna.ma/ar/get-bassin on 2026-10-16. The dashboard headline reads 2026-10-12; the JSON response supplies no observation date. No explicit reuse license was identified.

notes: Coverage combines five Tensift dams with daily August–September 2026 observations from ABHT and 22 selected Maadialna dams across nine basins. Two dams appear in both sources, giving 25 unique dams.
The Maadialna snapshot date is based on its dashboard headline, not an observation-date field in the JSON; date_basis identifies this difference.
Source licenses apply separately. ABHT records retain ODbL attribution. No explicit reuse license was identified for Maadialna, whose review remains pending.
This is a static snapshot of selected dams, not a complete national dam registry or a live service.
Original ABHT observation values and source references are preserved. The monthly workbook row 2 capacity remains attached to its original observations only.
No capacities, French translations, coordinates or administrative joins are inferred for Maadialna entries.
Resources retain their own attribution, date basis, retrieval time and SHA-256 fingerprint; raw source files are not included.
attribution: Source-specific attribution and licensing are recorded on each resource. ABHT resources remain under ODbL 1.0; no license is asserted for Maadialna. The source code license is separate.
